biden-family-3.title: Foreign money by country
lines: Committee staff records, not court or Treasury findings. Same method for both: amounts as each House committee report states them. No Treasury or FinCEN master list exists for either.
Biden family, by country

China: Over $8 million, CEFC and related entities. State Energy HK wired $3 million on Mar 1, 2017 (family got about $1,065,692); Northern International Capital sent $5 million to Hudson West III on Aug 8, 2017, and $400,000 went to Owasco the same day. Source · Source
Ukraine: Burisma. Committee total: $6.5 million. Source
more: Russia: Yelena Baturina, $3.5 million to a shell company tied to Hunter Biden and Devon Archer, Feb 2014. Source · Source
Romania: Gabriel Popoviciu: over $3 million to a Biden associate’s account; about $1.038 million reached family accounts. Source
Mexico, Oman: named by the committee; amounts not documented. Source
Impeachment inquiry report: “over $27 million from foreign individuals or entities” Source. Monthly payments from Owasco Source.

“at a minimum, $7.8 million in foreign payments from at least 20 countries during his presidency” Report · Report part 2. Unreported foreign gifts: more than 100, “over a quarter of a million dollars” Source. Trump Organization pledge to donate foreign-government profits to Treasury Source; Treasury receipts: not documented. Trump Hotel DC GSA estimate $3,787,485: Not yet verified.
